header: The page's regular plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, 2-3 minutes with every timeout counted: the
launcher, Load ROM once the page has its shader list (Chrome builds the whole list behind the launcher and says when
it is done: a laptop's GPU busy with it took no click until it was done; Firefox builds none there, and its line
saying so is the one waited for), Start Game, then the title (the game's state 2, read in RDRAM: in Firefox the
console line saying so comes before the plan plays) and a Normal Championship's first race, Sunny Beach, as
tools/shader_plan.json's second championship section plays it: the menus passed by pressing until the game's state
(gGameState, 0x800DAB24) says the next screen is up, a need that the race is on, and the race raced 60 s of the
game's own time (the frame counter at 0x80151960, 20 a second) with the gas held and tools/autopilot.js steering.
tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on through the race's finish to two more races, for when a longer play is needed.
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
play: new Promise((r) => { const t0 = Date.now(), i = setInterval(() => { const s = n64r(0x800DAB24); if (s >= 2 || Date.now() - t0 > 15000) { clearInterval(i); r("state 0x" + s.toString(16)); } }, 100); })

(clearInterval(window.noRetire), window.noRetire = setInterval(() => { for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) { const a = 0x801C2938 + s * 0x378 + 0x2E8, v = n64r(a); if (v > 0 && v < 40) n64w(a, 59); } }, 1), 0)
